_meta.revised: 2026-10-04, post-review (human): the shims run their engines as modules. Four values re-observed: s060.{link-outside,copy-outside}, tree variable unset, for --tags and the listing. A shim outside any checkout still resolves no tree, as at the base; python3 now reports the engine module missing (exit 1) instead of the engine file missing (exit 2). Every other value is the base capture, unchanged. 2026-10-08 (#1206, human-decided): orient frames the Lessons section's Viable tags and Hits bodies as untrusted under a one-line note; every s062.orient section was re-observed, and each equals the prior value once the note and the frames are removed. norm() masks the frame salt as <SALT>. 2026-10-08 (#1206, human-decided): a search now runs over each lesson's frontmatter as one key: value line per key in the one-line spelling --tags lists (Lesson.match_text), not the raw YAML text; s185's escaped-signature search for it's "quoted" now finds meta-quotes.md, which the raw text's YAML quoting hid. No other s185 value moved. 2026-10-08 (#1206, human-decided): the frontier block frames its hits as untrusted under the lead line; the six s185/s186/pushes values that hold a block were re-observed, and each equals the prior value once the frame lines are removed. 2026-10-08 (#1206): the Lessons note now stands only over framed text; s062's three sections with no framed text ('both lessons calls fail', 'both lessons calls empty', 'the shim is missing from the tree') lost the note and nothing else. 2026-10-08 (#1206 review, human-decided): defender-lessons --show prints each lesson's frontmatter inside a salted untrusted frame under its --- path line; every golden was re-observed, and each changed value equals the prior one once the frame lines are removed. 2026-10-16 (#1255, design rev 4 P1, the model view): the paths these blocks hand the model are rendered in the model view, the checkout at `/defender` — every s062.orient Hits line and both pushes blocks now name `/defender/lessons/<name>.md` where the base named the checkout's host path (`<TMP>/<tree>/defender/lessons/...`, or the linked corpus's host target `<TMP>/real-corpus-linked/...`: the view is lexical, so a link inside the checkout keeps its tree). Respelled, not re-observed (the contract precedes its implementation); no other value moved. Shim-direct values (s062.tags, the --show goldens) are unchanged: their callers hand host paths outside any run. 2026-10-22 (#1108 P4, O1/O2/O-TEXT, OD6): the product tree carries no lesson corpus; each test tree's corpus sits in an agent root beside its code copy (`<TMP>/<tree>/agent/lessons/`, a run copy's `agent/` in shape) that DEFENDER_AGENT_DIR names, and the model view names it `/agent/lessons/`. Respelled by rule, not re-observed (the contract precedes its implementation): `defender/lessons` -> `agent/lessons` in every key and value (host paths, argv spelled relative to the tenant repo root per OD6, model-view Hits and pushes lines); the escape rows keep naming an existing file outside the corpus: `defender/lessons/../pyproject.toml` -> `agent/lessons/../../defender/pyproject.toml`, `defender/lessons/../skills/invlang/SKILL.md` -> `agent/lessons/../../defender/skills/invlang/SKILL.md`; the retired-corpus row `defender/lessons-actor/_TEMPLATE.md` (U5) -> `agent/lessons-questioner/_TEMPLATE.md` (a sibling corpus file the test plants). No other value moved. Sections s132, s146, s186, wrapper and pushes have no producer in test_1080_lessons_engine.py (no test reads them); respelled for consistency only.
